title: Surreal Fleur-de-Lis Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant melting pink and green Fleur-de-Lis with blue drips flowing into a starry river that winds through a dark landscape. The night sky swirls with purple and blue clouds, lightning, and stars, while glowing orbs containing tiny silhouetted figures, melting clocks, flowers, and a large tree with exposed roots occupy the scene.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape featuring a massive melting pink and green Fleur-de-Lis dripping blue liquid into a glowing starry river that flows through dark terrain. The swirling purple and blue night sky contains stars, lightning, and a large tree with exposed roots hanging from the top right. Scattered throughout are glowing circular orbs with silhouetted figures inside, melting clocks on the ground, orange flowers, and luminous purple and blue flower-like structures, in a vibrant colorful painterly style.
